chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 46: The Flesh Buddha Reveals Its True Face
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang sees Zhengde Temple's true deity—a writhing, parasitic mountain of flesh. His worldview shatters as he realizes there is no good or evil, only gang wars between monsters.
og_title: Li Huowang Sees the True Buddha of Zhengde Temple
og_description: In this chapter of Dao Gui Yi Xian, Li Huowang finally uncovers the monstrous truth behind the pious facade of Zhengde Temple. There is no good or evil. Only monsters pretending to be saints.
twitter_description: He thought these monks were the good guys. He was wrong. The Flesh Buddha is real.
